title: Story Saver for IG - HD Format
summary: Download Stories, Images, Videos in HD Format
description:
Download HD photos, stories, or videos quickly. It is a super fast🚀 and Unbelievably simple free app for story saver, status Saver, Video downloader

Story Saver for IG helps you save images and videos in high quality. You can easily download  Video/ Photo/ Story/ Reels/Highlight  from IG to your phone.

Story Saver for IG is a simple and fast app to view the stories of the people you follow and download images/videos such as IGTV, reels, stories, highlights, and profile pictures in HD quality on your device so that you can view them later and even when you are offline. 

MAIN FEATURES OF THE APP:

🖼️Save Images & Video Stories:
View all the images and videos in the app and you can quickly glance at all the thumbnails just like the Gallery.

🖼️View & Save Posts With HD Quality:
In the app, you can view anyone's posts and download them in high resolution. It supports both image & video posts.

📌 View Highlight Stories:
You can also view and download the highlight stories of the people you follow.

📽️ Inbuilt Video Player:
The video stories can be played inside the app itself for the best user experience.

😀 Simple & Beautiful User Interface:
The user interface is fine-tuned for the perfect user experience of viewing the stories.

💾 Save & Share:
You can save any story and share it with your friends. Also, you can delete any saved story if you don't need it anymore.

Other Features:
★ Simple and secured login
★ Save story and highlight
★ Save IG photos/videos
★ View stories anonymously
★ Download high-quality profile photo
★ Swipe to go to next/previous stories
★ Delete multiple stories at once
★ Zoom option to view the image stories
★ Watch offline videos anytime, anywhere
